footnote: Source: Gomes and Fontinha, Portugal pilot final report, Jul 2024, 21 firms. Image is AI-generated
notes: If each hour must produce 25% more, the hours that produce nothing have to go first. In Portugal's government-backed pilot, only 8% of the firms that made two or more process changes went back to five days, against 38% of those that made one change or none. We are making four changes. Meetings default to 30 minutes, Wednesday mornings are meeting-free, and anything over an hour needs the department head's approval. Weekly status meetings become one written update. Routine approvals need no more than two signatures. Most important, every department files a stop-doing list by November 30, naming the reports and steps it will drop during the trial.
